description: The International Levee Performance Dataset collects levee failures, breaches, incidents and large-scale experiments contributed by third parties. The SAFElevee project archive lists worldwide coverage for 1800 to 2020 and a later second version. This resource is provided by SAFelevee Project; 4TU.ResearchData. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists ZIP, JSON, PDF, XLSM, JPEG formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC0-1.0; provider also asks that original data owners be cited. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The opened URL is version 1. Contributors must be credited despite the CC0 metadata, and heterogeneous historical cases are incomplete. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
